name: @pipeworx/mcp-telnyx-lookup

tools.name: telnyx_number_lookup
tools.description: Look up carrier, caller-name (CNAM), and number-portability/LRN data for a phone number using the Telnyx Number Lookup API. Returns the carrier name and line type (mobile/landline/voip), the CNAM caller name, and portability details (ported status, local routing number, city/state). Example: telnyx_number_lookup({ phone_number: "+18665552368", _apiKey: "your-key" })

phone_number.description: Phone number to look up, in E.164 format including the leading "+" and country code, e.g. "+18665552368".

type.description: Which enrichments to request: "carrier" (carrier name + line type) and/or "caller-name" (CNAM). Defaults to both. Portability data is always returned.

_apiKey.description: Telnyx API key (created in the Mission Control portal at https://telnyx.com).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-telnyx-lookup forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the telnyx-lookup pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
